# Week Index

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A hub note for a given week that links to and organizes its constituent Day Cluster notes and other weekly artifacts.

## Scope note

Navigational role within WeekCluster, analogous to the Index hub notes in the Effort/Output Cluster design.

## Broader

- [Week Cluster](../WeekCluster/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
